claim_being_audited: The model is supportably certifiable for launch readiness now based on aggregate pass and no severity-one rehearsal incidents, provided the model card discloses the remaining material limitation in the enterprise refund workflow because the mitigation artifact is still only a draft.
decision_criteria: If admissible records confirm aggregate readiness passed the governing threshold and the release policy expressly allows certification with disclosed unresolved limitations, the verdict would move toward compliant_with_caveats.
If an approved mitigation or risk acceptance with owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion exists, and it covers the named gap, the support for certification strengthens materially.
If the final model card is shown to disclose the enterprise refund workflow limitation clearly, the disclosure-side concern is reduced.
If the underlying evidence contradicts the claimed pass, incident status, or policy interpretation, the verdict would move to noncompliant.
evidence_requests: Provide the underlying aggregate readiness report showing the target, actual score, date, evaluator, and sign-off for ISTRESS-DRAFT-MITIGATION-002-AGGREGATE-PASS.
Provide the rehearsal incident log or postmortem establishing there were no severity-one incidents and clarifying whether lower-severity near-misses affected certification criteria.
Provide the underlying policy or release-standard text that expressly permits certification with a disclosed unresolved material limitation, or the approved risk-acceptance record if one exists.
Provide the current model card draft or approval record showing the refund-workflow limitation is explicitly disclosed.
Provide the draft mitigation artifact itself to confirm the missing owner/threshold/review-date/rollback elements and whether any later approved version exists.
specific_concerns: Evidence access is limited to the Actor's summary; the underlying records, thresholds, and approval artifacts are not independently available to confirm the claimed aggregate pass, incident severity, or policy interpretation.
The packet appears to support a disclosure obligation more clearly than it supports unconditional certification; a named launch use-case slice remains below target and the mitigation is not approved.

The policy text provided establishes when certification without material caveats is allowed, but it does not independently show that certification with a disclosed unresolved limitation is authorized on the present record.
There is no admissible evidence here that the final model card actually contains the required limitation disclosure or that any approved risk acceptance exists.
Public governance sources can support general documentation and risk-management principles, but they do not substitute for internal approval predicates or release-policy thresholds.
unsupported_claims: That certification is affirmatively supportable on the present record, rather than merely not yet disproven, is not independently established from the admissible evidence provided to this role.
That aggregate readiness pass and absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents are sufficient certification predicates despite the below-target named launch slice is not independently shown.
That the cited public governance materials materially support the specific internal certification decision, rather than only the disclosure/risk-management framing, is overstated.
